other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a resident of Meghalaya
Beneficiary must be engaged in any building or other construction work
Beneficiary must be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Beneficiary must have completed 3 years of membership in the fund
Beneficiary is prohibited from selling the tools purchased and is not entitled to a second grant
benefits_summary: One-time grant of up to ₹10,000 for purchase of tools.
